runbook: R-18 / R-19 (independent oracle, blind to diff/plan/src/tests/scripts)

evidence_tree.built_with: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>

sources.quote: Active: Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere at the target location that appears after a 0.6-second delay, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies. The Dark Sphere then remains on the ground for 6 seconds.

sources.reading: Dark Sphere per-cast magic damage = 90/125/160/195/230 (+ 70% AP)

sources.quote: Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.
sources.reading: At >= 40 splinters the ability banks a second charge. The wiki text attaches NO damage modifier to the stocked charge and NO separate leveling row: the stocked charge is an ordinary Dark Sphere cast at full damage. Max charges 2 => exactly one extra cast beyond the primary Q cast.

sources.quote: At 120 Splinters of Wrath, Syndra achieves Transcendence, increasing her ability power by 15%.
sources.reading: The AP amplifier threshold is 120, NOT 60. At 60 splinters no AP buff applies, so a Dark Sphere cast at 60 splinters uses unmodified AP.

sources.quote: Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 60 Splinters of Wrath enhances Force of Will to deal 12% (+ 2% per 100 AP) bonus true damage.
sources.reading: Confirms the splinter ladder 40 (Q charge) / 60 (W true damage) / 80 (E) / 100 (R execute) / 120 (AP buff). The scenario suffix '60' sits above the 40 threshold, so the Q second charge IS unlocked.

sources.quote: modeled: [P, Q, Q2, W, E, R] ... 'modeled = SLOTS keys incl. synthetic Q2 (2nd charge)'; atoms: 'ammo (Q 2nd charge at 40 splinters)'
sources.reading: Q2 is the sourced, audited slot name for the 40-splinter stocked Dark Sphere charge.

sources.quote: E3 implemented the Transcendent splinter system (splinters option: 120 -> 1.15x AP buff, 40+ Q charges via Q2 slot, 60+ W true damage), R sphere count (r_spheres).
sources.reading: Independent confirmation that a splinters=60 configuration must expose the Q2 slot (60 >= 40).

sources.locator: Section 5 formula-audit table, rows 'Resistance mitigation' and 'Stat rounding'
sources.quote: m(R)=100/(100+R) ... EXACT | Stat rounding (calculate_total_stats): display-level integer rounding of health/AD/AP/armor/MR before damage
sources.reading: Mitigation is exactly raw * 100/(100+MR), and AP entering a scaling is an integer. Both facts are used in the feasibility check below.

step_1_should_the_leaf_exist.rule: S3 + S5: the stocked Dark Sphere charge unlocks at 40 Splinters of Wrath.
step_1_should_the_leaf_exist.conclusion: A Q2 ('Dark Sphere (2nd charge)') entry MUST appear in the breakdown for this scenario. The old state (<absent>) omitted damage the champion demonstrably deals, i.e. it under-counted the rotation by one full Dark Sphere.

step_2_cast_count.rule: S3: 'up to a maximum of 2' charges.
step_2_cast_count.conclusion: The banked charge yields exactly one extra Dark Sphere cast beyond the primary Q cast in a single burst rotation. casts = 1 is correct; casts = 2 would double-count the primary Q.

step_3_per_cast_damage_formula.formula: Dark Sphere damage = base(rank) + 0.70 * AP,  base = [90, 125, 160, 195, 230] for ranks 1..5   (source S2)
modifiers_that_do_NOT_apply_at_60_splint: W 60-splinter bonus true damage (W-only, source S5)
any charge-specific damage penalty (none exists in the wiki text, source S3)
step_3_per_cast_damage_formula.therefore: Q2.total_damage must equal exactly one Q cast: base(rank) + 0.70 * AP, with no splinter amplification.

step_4_lattice_check_of_650.method: Solve 650 = base(rank) + 0.70 * AP for each rank; a correct engine value must land on this lattice with a realizable (integer, per S8) AP.
step_4_lattice_check_of_650.note: Every solution is an exact whole number (the 35-per-rank base step divided by the 0.70 AP ratio is exactly 50 AP), so 650.0 lies exactly on the Dark Sphere damage lattice. Rank 5 + 600 AP is the natural reading for a maxed-Q, full-AP-build scenario.
step_4_lattice_check_of_650.mitigation_feasibility: If total_damage were post-mitigation instead of raw, then raw = 650*(100+MR)/100 = 650 + 6.5*MR, and integrality of AP (S8) forces 65*MR/7 to be an integer, i.e. MR must be a multiple of 7. Sweeping MR = 0..150 leaves only MR in {0, 7, 14, 21, ...}; for any conventional target MR (25, 30, 40, 50, 100) no integer AP reproduces 650.0. So 650.0 is consistent only with a zero-MR / pre-mitigation reading of this breakdown row - a self-consistent, non-arbitrary number in either case.
falsification_attempts: If the engine had wrongly amplified the charge by the 120-splinter +15% AP buff, the value would be base + 0.70*1.15*AP, which is off-lattice for round AP (e.g. rank 5, AP 600 -> 713.0, not 650.0).
If the engine had wrongly charged the W 60-splinter true-damage rider onto Q2, the value would carry a 12% + 2%/100AP true-damage term (e.g. +24% at 600 AP), again off-lattice.
If the engine had halved or otherwise discounted the stocked charge, the value would not equal a whole Dark Sphere; the wiki text authorizes no such discount.
650.0 survives all three: it is exactly one unmodified Dark Sphere.

independent_computation.step_5_verdict_logic: The leaf must exist (60 >= 40 threshold), must carry casts = 1 (max 2 charges), must be named for the second Dark Sphere charge, and must equal one unmodified Dark Sphere = base(rank) + 0.70*AP. The new value satisfies all four constraints and 650.0 sits exactly on that lattice. The old state omitted the slot entirely, which contradicts the 40-splinter Transcendent Bonus quoted in S3.

limitations.note: The scenario's attacker stats (level, ability ranks, item build / AP) and the manual target's resistances are defined outside the permitted evidence tree (scripts/, tests/), so the exact (rank, AP) pair behind 650.0 could not be read directly. The verification is therefore: (a) structural - the slot's existence, name and cast count are forced by the cached wiki text; and (b) numeric-lattice - 650.0 is an exact solution of the sourced Dark Sphere formula for a realizable whole-number AP at every rank, and is NOT reproducible by any of the plausible mis-modelings enumerated in step_4.falsification_attempts.
limitations.residual_risk: A scenario whose true AP/rank pair is not one of the five listed pairs would make 650.0 wrong; nothing readable from data/ suggests that, and all five pairs are ordinary Syndra configurations.
